name: Invoice review
description: Read an invoice, recompute the total, and decide whether it can be paid automatically.

steps.name: extract
steps.instruction: Extract the invoice id, every line item (quantity, description, unit price) and the tax rate.
steps.criteria: Every line item and number must appear in the invoice exactly.

steps.name: total
steps.instruction: Compute each line total, the subtotal, the tax and the grand total from the extracted data. Round money to cents.
steps.criteria: Recompute the arithmetic; total must equal subtotal plus tax.

steps.name: decision
steps.instruction: If the total is at most 500.00, the decision is auto-approve; otherwise needs sign-off. Give the decision and a one-line reason.
